intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Kyle for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from December 6 through Sunday, December 20, with Holiday on the Square with Santa's arrival, Grinch on the Green and the Kyle Community Christmas Nativity Open House (December 12 and 13). New in this update: Pictures with Santa at Texas Old Town Stone Hall (Sunday, December 6), Brunch with Mrs. Claus at the Adell Hurst Senior Community Center (Sunday, December 20) and the Winter Wonderland for All Abilities Dance at Gemstone Palace (Friday, December 18). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Texas Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Kyle families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Austin, which covers the Austin Trail of Lights, the Zilker Holiday Tree, the North Pole Flyer train ride and dozens of free family events across the area.

Planning Christmas Eve in Kyle? Families look for candlelight and family services too, so see Christmas Eve service times in Kyle.

What Rally found in Kyle

  • 7 family events, 4 of them free
  • Meet Santa: Holiday on the Square, when Santa arrives; Pictures with Santa at Texas Old Town Stone Hall, Sunday, December 6; and Brunch with Mrs. Claus at the Adell Hurst Senior Community Center, Sunday, December 20
  • Tree lightings and parades: Holiday on the Square, the city's Santa arrival and tree lighting evening
  • Also on the list: a nativity open house with a Songs of the Savior concert and an all abilities dance
  • Season: through December 20, 2026
  • Every date checked on the host's own site on Nov 25
